about: Owner and service manager of a small boatyard doing engine work, repaints and winter storage

messages.subject: Charger keeps switching off
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

Quick one. Since Pelikaan moved into row C of the shed, the charger keeps shutting off overnight. I came by this morning and the batteries were down to 40%. Is something wrong with my charger or with the power there?

Cheers,
Rob

messages.subject: Re: Charger keeps switching off
messages.body:
Hi Rob,

Thanks for letting me know. I'll ask Joost to have a look this week and get back to you.

Best,
Maren

messages.subject: Landstrom Halle C
messages.body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Dekker,

der Landstrom an meinem Platz in Halle C fällt seit letzter Woche immer wieder aus. Mein Luftentfeuchter läuft dann nicht, und ich mache mir Sorgen wegen Schimmel im Boot. Könnten Sie das bitte prüfen lassen?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Klaus Brenner

messages.subject: Re: Landstrom Halle C
messages.body:
Sehr geehrter Herr Brenner,

vielen Dank für Ihre Nachricht. Wir schauen uns das an und melden uns bei Ihnen.

Viele Grüße
Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Breaker on my post
messages.body: Hi Maren, the breaker on the post next to my spot (C6, right by Zeeslang) keeps clicking off as soon as the dehumidifier and the battery charger both run. I reset it twice today. Is there another socket I can use? Thanks, Sanne

messages.subject: Re: Breaker on my post
messages.body: Hi Sanne, sorry about that. Please run just one of them for now, I'll get back to you next week. Maren

messages.subject: Shed inventory notes
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

Did the inventory in the shed today. Fire extinguishers all checked, two need a refill. Ladder 3 has a cracked step, I took it out.

Also noticed the power pedestals in row C (C1 to C8) have 10A breakers, rows A and B have 16A. Lumen did row C in August when the shed was extended. No idea if it matters, just noting it for the file.

Joost

messages.subject: Invoice HC-30871
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Please find attached invoice HC-30871 dated 21 September 2026.

12 x Seaguard HF copper-free hard antifouling 5L @ 89.00 = 1,068.00
2 x Thinner 5L @ 24.00 = 48.00
Total excl. VAT: 1,116.00

Payment within 30 days.

Kind regards,
Harbor Coatings

messages.subject: Invoice HC-31502
messages.body:
Dear customer,

Please find attached invoice HC-31502 dated 22 October 2026.

8 x Seaguard HF copper-free hard antifouling 5L @ 104.00 = 832.00
Total excl. VAT: 832.00

Please note that our price list was adjusted as of 1 October 2026.

Payment within 30 days.

Kind regards,
Harbor Coatings

messages.subject: Spring bookings so far
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

Quick update on spring: 31 boats booked for a bottom job so far and the list keeps growing. Joost reckons about 1.5 tins each, so 45 to 50 tins of antifouling by March.

Femke

messages.subject: Our offer: Tidecoat HF
messages.body:
Dear Maren,

Nice talking to you at the trade day. As promised, here is our offer:

Tidecoat HF copper-free hard antifouling 5L, same spec class as what you use now: 81.00 per tin from 20 tins. Free delivery above 1,500 excl. VAT. Valid until 31 January 2027.

Happy to send a sample tin if you want to try it on one hull first.

Best regards,
Ilse Brouwer
Tidemark Marine Supply

messages.subject: Re: Our offer: Tidecoat HF
messages.body: Hi Ilse, thanks for sending this. I'll look at it and come back to you. Maren

messages.subject: Travel lift inspection for policy renewal
messages.body:
Dear Ms Dekker,

For the renewal of your yard policy per 1 January we need the annual inspection of the 35-ton travel lift. I can come on Wednesday November 18 from 8:00.

Please note the lift must be out of service that whole day: we do a load test with test weights and check the slings, brakes and hydraulics.

Kind regards,
Ruud Smit
Surveyor, Kustpolis Insurance

messages.subject: Re: Travel lift inspection for policy renewal
messages.body:
Dear Mr Smit,

Wednesday November 18 should work. I'll confirm by Friday.

Kind regards,
Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Windekind coming in
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

Just confirming what I agreed with Femke: we bring Windekind round on Wednesday the 18th, around 10:00, for the lift-out and winter storage. Could the mast come down the same day? My crew is only free that day.

Thanks,
Bart

messages.subject: Sail repairs?
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

Our sail loft closed this autumn (the owner retired) and we have 12 training mainsails that need new batten pockets and some patching before April. Do you happen to know someone good? You know everybody at the harbour.

Groetjes,
Marloes
Windkracht Sailing School

messages.subject: Re: Sail repairs?
messages.body: Hi Marloes, good question, let me think about who could take that on. I'll let you know. Maren

messages.subject: Kennismaking: zeilmakerij aan de Havenweg
messages.body:
Beste Maren,

Mijn naam is Daan Hofman. Sinds deze maand heb ik een eigen zeilmakerij in de oude loods aan de Havenweg, vlak bij jullie werf. Ik heb jaren bij een grote zeilmaker gewerkt en zoek nu vooral voor de winter werk: reparaties, nieuwe lattenzakken, UV-stroken, en ook grotere aantallen tegelijk.

Mocht je klanten hebben die iets nodig hebben, dan hoor ik het graag. Kom gerust een keer langs voor koffie.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Daan Hofman

messages.subject: My birthday
messages.body:
Hi love,

I know you're busy with the boats, but my 70th is on Saturday the 28th of November. I don't want a big fuss, but it would be lovely to have everybody at one table for once. Maybe the fish restaurant by the dike? Your father says I shouldn't ask, but I'm asking.

Love, Mum

messages.subject: Guess what
messages.body: Sis! Booked my flights: landing Thursday Nov 26 at 14:10, flying back Monday the 30th. Can I stay at yours? And don't tell Mum, I want to surprise her. T.

messages.subject: Re: Guess what
messages.body: Yes!! The sofa bed is yours. My lips are sealed. x

messages.subject: Garage clear-out
messages.body: Hey Maren! We're finally clearing out the garage. The double bike trailer is up for grabs, the kids are too big for it now. Free to a friend, otherwise it goes on the marketplace at the end of the month. Also have a box of Lego if Bram still wants it. x Lotte

messages.subject: trailer advice?
messages.body: Hi sis, any tips for a second-hand bike trailer? New ones are 600+ and I need one by December when Fien switches daycare (the new one is 4 km away). No car, as you know. A.

messages.subject: Invoice 1147
messages.body:
Dear Ms Dekker,

Invoice 1147: mobile crane for mast stepping on 2 October, 4 hours @ 145.00 = 580.00 excl. VAT. Payment within 14 days please.

Regards,
Hijskraan Noord

messages.subject: Your order 1147 has shipped
messages.body: Good news! Your order 1147 (10 x nitrile gloves, size L) is on its way. Track your parcel in your account.

messages.subject: Booking confirmed: Friday December 4
messages.body:
Dear Maren,

Thank you for your booking. We look forward to welcoming your group of 9 for the Christmas lunch on Friday December 4 at 12:30. Please let us know about dietary wishes a week ahead.

Warm regards,
De Zoute Kant

messages.subject: Mooring contract
messages.body: Hi Maren, my mooring contract ends December 4 and I won't renew it. The boat goes up north to my son's harbour. Thanks for all the years. Gerrit

messages.subject: Re: Mooring contract
messages.body: Hi Gerrit, sorry to see you go, but I understand. Noted. I'll send you the final statement before then. All the best, Maren

messages.subject: Rudder play
messages.body: Hello Maren, my Kestrel 28 has some play in the rudder since the summer. Can you check the bearing when she comes out of the water? Thanks, Erik

messages.subject: Re: Rudder play
messages.body: Hi Erik, sure, I've added it to the work order. Maren

messages.subject: Your Kestrel Books plan
messages.body:
Hi Maren,

Your Kestrel Books plan renews on November 30. From then the Standard plan is 29 per month. If you switch to annual billing you get two months free. Want me to set that up?

Best,
Daniel
Kestrel Books

messages.subject: Zilvermeeuw stern gland
messages.body: Morning Maren, the stern gland on Zilvermeeuw is dripping more than usual, maybe a cup a day. Can Joost look at it before winter? Henk

messages.subject: Dripping stuffing box
messages.body: Hi Maren, writing from home this time. Did you get my mail about the stuffing box on my boat? It's still leaking a bit. Would like it repacked while she's on the hard. Henk

messages.subject: Quote: workshop heating
messages.body:
Dear Ms Dekker,

Following our visit, our quote for replacing the gas heater in your workshop with two infrared panels and a new thermostat: 4,850 excl. VAT, installation in 2 days. Quote valid 30 days.

Kind regards,
Warmtek

messages.subject: Your boiler service is due
messages.body: Dear Ms Dekker, your annual boiler service is due. Reply to this email or call us to book a slot. Kind regards, HomeWarm Service

messages.subject: Lithium batteries in winter storage: what yards need to know
messages.body: This week: three shed fires this season traced to lithium batteries left on charge. What insurers are starting to ask, and how other yards set rules for chargers. Plus: the new apprenticeship subsidy explained.

messages.subject: Bulletin: fire safety in storage sheds
messages.body: Our autumn bulletin: lithium battery fires in storage sheds are on the rise. Read our five tips for safe charging over winter and download the checklist for your customers.

messages.subject: Shrink-wrap price?
messages.body: Hi Maren, what would it cost to have Spray shrink-wrapped this winter instead of the canvas cover? She's 9.5 m. Regards, Pieter

messages.subject: Price for wrapping my boat
messages.body:
Hello Maren,

A friend at the club had her boat shrink-wrapped at your yard last year and was very happy. Could you give me a price for my 8 m motorboat?

Kind regards,
Carla Smits

messages.subject: Anodes Morgenster
messages.body: Maren, any news on the anodes for Morgenster? I'd like one last weekend out before she comes out of the water and Joost said not without new zincs. Johan

messages.subject: Backorder shaft anodes
messages.body: Hi Maren, the 30 mm shaft anodes are on backorder. We expect them Monday and will ship the same day. Sorry for the wait. Gert, Zinkhuis

messages.subject: Morgenster done
messages.body: Anodes for Morgenster came in yesterday, fitted them this morning. Johan's boat is good to go, I already told him. Joost

messages.subject: Free tickets: Northern Boat Show
messages.body: Hi Maren, we have a stand at the Northern Boat Show on Saturday October 24 and I've put four free trade tickets aside for you. Come by stand 112 and we'll show the new engine range. Leon, Brightline Marine

messages.subject: Boat show?
messages.body: Hi Maren, are you going to the boat show on the 24th? I'd like to look at new engines together before I decide on the repower. Victor

messages.subject: Referral arrangement
messages.body:
Dear Maren,

With the shed filling up, you probably know which owners are thinking about selling. We'd be happy to pay a 1% referral fee for any listing that comes to us through you. Shall we have a coffee?

Wim Roos
Harborline Brokers

messages.subject: Working together on used boats
messages.body: Hi Maren, Seaward Yachts is growing its used-boat desk. Would you be open to a referral arrangement for owners in your shed who want to sell? We can also do valuations on site. Best, Nadia

messages.subject: Aanvraag omgevingsvergunning loods
messages.body:
Geachte mevrouw Dekker,

Wij hebben uw aanvraag voor de nieuwe stalling ontvangen. Voor de beoordeling missen wij nog een tekening met de afstand tot de dijk. Kunt u deze binnen vier weken aanleveren?

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Vergunningen, Gemeente Havenstad

messages.subject: Re: Aanvraag omgevingsvergunning loods
messages.body:
Geachte heer, mevrouw,

Dank voor uw bericht. Ik vraag de tekening op bij onze architect en stuur hem zo snel mogelijk.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Re: Aanvraag omgevingsvergunning loods
messages.body:
Geachte mevrouw Dekker,

Dank voor de tekening. Wilt u ook de hoogte van de nok aangeven op de gevelaanzichten? Daarna kunnen wij de aanvraag in behandeling nemen.

Met vriendelijke groet,
Team Vergunningen

messages.subject: Winterstalling sloep
messages.body: Hoi Maren, kan mijn sloep deze winter binnen staan in plaats van buiten op de bok? Ze is 6,5 meter. Groet, Kees

messages.subject: Re: Winterstalling sloep
messages.body: Hoi Kees, dat kan, we hebben nog twee plekken in rij A. Binnen kost 38 per meter voor het seizoen. Zal ik je inschrijven? Groet, Maren

messages.subject: Re: Winterstalling sloep
messages.body: Top, doe maar. Ik breng haar half oktober. Kees

messages.subject: Btw-aangifte Q3
messages.body:
Hallo Maren,

Voor de btw-aangifte van het derde kwartaal mis ik nog de bonnen van de brandstofsteiger en de factuur van de nieuwe lier. Kun je die voor vrijdag sturen?

Groet,
Mirjam

messages.subject: Re: Btw-aangifte Q3
messages.body: Hoi Mirjam, hierbij de bonnen en de factuur van de lier. Laat maar weten als er nog iets mist. Maren

messages.subject: Hivernage de mon voilier
messages.body:
Bonjour Maren,

Est-ce que vous pouvez faire l'hivernage complet de mon voilier cette année, moteur compris (antigel, vidange, filtres) ? Je serai en France jusqu'en avril.

Merci d'avance,
Céline Marchand

messages.subject: Re: Hivernage de mon voilier
messages.body:
Bonjour Céline,

Oui, bien sûr. Nous faisons l'hivernage complet avec le moteur, environ 420 euros hors TVA. Je vous envoie des photos quand le bateau est sorti de l'eau.

Cordialement,
Maren

messages.subject: Lieferung Drahtseil
messages.body:
Sehr geehrte Frau Dekker,

das bestellte Drahtseil 8 mm (60 m) ist fertig. Sollen wir es per Spedition schicken oder holen Sie es ab?

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Seilerei Krüger

messages.subject: Re: Lieferung Drahtseil
messages.body:
Guten Tag,

bitte per Spedition an unsere Werft. Vielen Dank!

Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Heg
messages.body: Hoi Maren, zullen we zaterdag samen de heg tussen onze tuinen snoeien? Ik heb een nieuwe heggenschaar. Groet, Frits

messages.subject: Re: Heg
messages.body: Goed plan Frits, zaterdag rond tien uur? Ik zorg voor koffie.

messages.subject: Nieuwsbrief oktober
messages.body: In deze nieuwsbrief: nieuwe regels voor vaarbewijzen, de ledenvergadering in maart en tips voor het winterklaar maken van uw boot.

messages.subject: Rijden zaterdag
messages.body: Hoi ouders van de JO11, wie kan zaterdag rijden naar de uitwedstrijd? We vertrekken om 8:15 bij het clubhuis. Graag even reageren. Ruben

messages.subject: Re: Rijden zaterdag
messages.body: Hoi Ruben, ik kan rijden, er passen drie kinderen naast Bram. Maren

messages.subject: Engine service quote
messages.body:
Hello Maren,

I'd like a quote for a full service on the twin diesels of my motor cruiser, Blue Heron. Oil, filters, impellers, and a look at the exhaust elbows which seem a bit crusty. She's in berth 14.

Many thanks,
Alan Brooks

messages.subject: Re: Engine service quote
messages.body:
Hi Alan,

For both engines: 6 hours labour plus parts, about 1,150 excl. VAT. The elbows we'll inspect and quote separately if they need replacing.

Best,
Maren

messages.subject: Re: Engine service quote
messages.body: That's fine, please go ahead. Any day next week suits me. Alan

messages.subject: Holiday request
messages.body: Hi Maren, can I take December 21 to January 1 off? Visiting my in-laws. Joost

messages.subject: Re: Holiday request
messages.body: Approved, enjoy! Maren

messages.subject: Photos for the website
messages.body: Hi Maren, the photographer can come on a weekday morning to shoot the yard and the shed for the new website. Which day suits? Femke

messages.subject: Re: Photos for the website
messages.body: Thursday works, before the lift gets busy. Thanks Femke.

messages.subject: Forklift service due
messages.body: Dear customer, the annual service of your forklift is due. We can come on Tuesday or Thursday next week. Please let us know which day suits.

messages.subject: Re: Forklift service due
messages.body: Tuesday please, from 8:00. Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Financing the new shed
messages.body:
Dear Ms Dekker,

Thank you for your request about financing the new storage shed. I'd like to go through the figures with you. Would Wednesday or Thursday afternoon next week work?

Kind regards,
Jeroen Vos
Polderbank Business

messages.subject: Re: Financing the new shed
messages.body: Dear Mr Vos, Thursday at 14:00 works. I'll bring the quotes from the builder. Kind regards, Maren

messages.subject: Teak deck
messages.body: Hi Maren, the teak on my foredeck is lifting in a few places and some seams are gone. Could you give me a price to fix it over the winter? Photos attached. Lisa

messages.subject: Re: Teak deck
messages.body: Hi Lisa, from the photos: re-bed four planks and recaulk the foredeck seams, roughly 1,600 excl. VAT. We can do it in January. Maren

messages.subject: Re: Teak deck
messages.body: Great, go ahead. January is perfect. Lisa

messages.subject: Invoice diesel delivery fuel dock
messages.body: Invoice for the delivery of 4,000 liters of marine diesel to your fuel dock. Amount due within 14 days. Thank you for your order.

messages.subject: Christmas on the water?
messages.body: Hi Maren, mad idea maybe, but we'd like to take Seagrass out between Christmas and New Year if the weather is kind. Can she stay in the water instead of coming out? Tom

messages.subject: Re: Christmas on the water?
messages.body: Hi Tom, not mad at all. She can stay in her berth, but you'll need the winter berth rate and a bubbler if it freezes. Shall I arrange the bubbler?

messages.subject: Re: Christmas on the water?
messages.body: Yes please, thanks! Tom

messages.subject: Apprenticeship application
messages.body:
Dear Ms Dekker,

I'm in my second year of the marine engineering course and I'm looking for an apprenticeship from February. I grew up sailing and have done engine work on my uncle's boat. My CV is attached.

Kind regards,
Sem Verbeek

messages.subject: Re: Apprenticeship application
messages.body: Hi Sem, thanks for your application. Can you come by for a chat on Friday November 13 at 15:00? You'll meet Joost too. Maren

messages.subject: Internship places 2027
messages.body: Dear Ms Dekker, we're planning internships for next year. Could your yard take one or two first-year students for six weeks in May and June? Kind regards, Linda Bos, internship coordinator

messages.subject: Re: Internship places 2027
messages.body: Dear Ms Bos, one student in May and June is possible. Please send me the paperwork. Kind regards, Maren

messages.subject: Dredging harbour entrance
messages.body: To all harbour users: the harbour entrance will be dredged from January 11 to January 22. Passage is possible but expect delays of up to one hour around high tide.

messages.subject: Charged twice?
messages.body: Hi Maren, I think I was charged twice for winter storage this month. Two debits of 342 on my account. Can you check? Ingrid

messages.subject: Re: Charged twice?
messages.body: Hi Ingrid, you're right, sorry about that. I've refunded one of them today, it should be on your account in two days. Maren

messages.subject: Re: Charged twice?
messages.body: Got it, thanks for the quick fix!

messages.subject: Wi-Fi extension for your shed
messages.body: Dear customer, regarding your request for Wi-Fi coverage in your storage shed: we can install two outdoor access points for 690 one-off plus 12 per month. Shall we schedule the installation?

messages.subject: Re: Wi-Fi extension for your shed
messages.body: Yes, please schedule it for the week of October 12. Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Diagnostic tool
messages.body: Maren, the old diagnostic laptop gave up today. Half the newer engines need it for the service reset. Can we buy a new kit? Joost

messages.subject: Re: Diagnostic tool
messages.body: Probably yes. Can you send me two or three options with prices?

messages.subject: Re: Diagnostic tool
messages.body: Will do, I'll send the options Monday.

messages.subject: Thank you
messages.body: Hi Maren, just wanted to say thanks to you and the team. The new cutlass bearing made a world of difference, she's quiet as a mouse. See you in spring. Paul

messages.subject: Bilge oil collection
messages.body: Dear customer, your waste oil tank is due for collection. We can come on Monday or Wednesday next week. Please confirm a day.

messages.subject: Re: Bilge oil collection
messages.body: Wednesday is fine. Thanks, Maren

messages.subject: Signed storage contract
messages.body: Hi Maren, attached the signed winter storage contract for Nachtegaal. Paid the deposit this morning. Noah

messages.subject: Re: Signed storage contract
messages.body: Thanks Noah, all received. See you at the lift-out.

messages.subject: AGM Wednesday November 25
messages.body: Dear members, the annual general meeting is on Wednesday November 25 at 19:30 in the clubhouse. On the agenda: the new harbour dues and the summer festival. Please let us know if you're coming.

messages.subject: Re: AGM Wednesday November 25
messages.body: I'll be there. Maren (Kielwater)

messages.subject: dinner
messages.body: I'm doing the shopping on the way home. Curry tonight or the soup from yesterday? x

messages.subject: Re: dinner
messages.body: Curry! Home by 7.

messages.subject: Reminder: your appointment
messages.body: This is a reminder of your checkup appointment. To reschedule, use the link in this email.

messages.subject: Book club at mine
messages.body: Hi Maren, book club is at mine this time, next Thursday. Did you finish the lighthouse novel? No pressure, wine either way. Esther

messages.subject: Re: Book club at mine
messages.body: Halfway! I'll be there and I'll bring cheese.

messages.subject: Re: Book club at mine
messages.body: Perfect, see you then x

messages.subject: Parent evening group 6
messages.body: Dear parents of Bram, you can sign up for a 10-minute talk at the parent evening on November 12 or 13. Please reply with your preferred day.

messages.subject: Re: Parent evening group 6
messages.body: Dear Mrs. Hartman, November 12 please, any time after 18:30. Kind regards, Maren Dekker

messages.subject: APK keuring
messages.body: Beste mevrouw Dekker, de APK van uw auto verloopt over een maand. Zullen we een afspraak maken? Wij hebben nog plek op dinsdag en vrijdag. Met vriendelijke groet, Garage Hoekstra

messages.subject: Re: APK keuring
messages.body: Goedemiddag, vrijdag 6 november om 8:00 graag. Groet, Maren Dekker

messages.subject: Spring visit
messages.body: Maren! I'll be in the country for work in April. Any chance of a sail if your own boat is back in the water by then? Jasper

messages.subject: Re: Spring visit
messages.body: Absolutely! She goes in mid-April, send me your dates when you know them.
